title: LG Energy Solution prepares LMR battery lines for GM at Tennessee joint venture, report says
html:
LG Energy Solution is preparing mass production lines for lithium manganese-rich (LMR) batteries at its Ultium Cells joint venture with General Motors (GM), and will soon begin equipment bidding, according to a report by The Elec citing industry...
